Name: CP - SH's Portraits for Mr. Ginger
Author: plurffle
Description:
I made this long ago and kept it for personal use, but I figured I might as well upload this because why not ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ

This is meant to be used for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]lemurkat's "Mister Ginger" mod[/url], which I love very much and this mod shall stay in my mods folder permanently (I also have an orange tabby cat in real life and I love her <3 )! I just wanted to make a more cartoony version of this character :3

How to Install:
[b][size=4]A.[/size][/b]
﻿1. Unzip the zip file.
﻿2. Just drop the extracted folder in your mods folder provided when you have Smapi installed. _(:3 」∠)_
[b]
[size=4]B.[/size][/b][i]Just in case the mod doesn't work:[/i]
﻿1. Copy the png file from this mod (which if I recall correctly, it's titled "MisterGingerPortraits.png")
﻿2. Replace the Mr. Ginger portraits in the original mod with the one that came from my mod (hopefully this will still be compatible unless Mr. Ginger gets some new portraits).



I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
